strategies.pine:
//@version=6
// =============================================================================
// H-002 · VWAP  —  board score 9.2/10  —  the only hypothesis still standing
// prop_lab · https://github.com/KristijonasSim/prop_lab
//
// Five model families around a session-anchored (or rolling) VWAP and its
// volume-weighted standard deviation bands.
//
// HONEST SCOPE. The board result is a FIVE-LEG BOOK — BTC 4h + ETH 1h + ETH 30m
// + SOL 4h + XAUUSD 5m, equal weight, each leg's config re-chosen blind every
// quarter by walk-forward. TradingView runs one symbol at a time, so this script
// is ONE LEG. It cannot reproduce the book's PF 1.772 / 1.418-at-2x on its own,
// and it does not re-pick its config each quarter the way the walk-forward does.
// Presets below are the MODE each leg selected most often since 2024-09.
//
// Costs: set commission to your real taker fee. The board's headline is measured
// at 2x cost (Binance spot taker 5bps + 2bps slippage per side = 14bps round
// trip). A result that only works at 1x is not a result.
// =============================================================================
strategy("H-002 VWAP · prop_lab", overlay=true, initial_capital=10000,
     default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=100,
     commission_type=strategy.commission.percent, commission_value=0.05,
     margin_long=100, margin_short=100, pyramiding=0, calc_on_every_tick=false)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- presets ---
preset = input.string("ETH 1h · break", "Board leg preset", options=[
     "BTC 4h · trend", "ETH 1h · break", "ETH 30m · reclaim",
     "SOL 4h · trend (rolling)", "XAUUSD 5m · break (rolling)", "Manual"],
     tooltip="The configuration each board leg picked most often since 2024-09. " +
             "Choose Manual to drive the inputs below yourself.")

// mode: 0 trend · 1 fade · 2 break · 3 reclaim · 4 pullback
pMode    = preset == "BTC 4h · trend" ? 0 : preset == "ETH 1h · break" ? 2 :
           preset == "ETH 30m · reclaim" ? 3 : preset == "SOL 4h · trend (rolling)" ? 0 :
           preset == "XAUUSD 5m · break (rolling)" ? 2 : -1
pBandK   = preset == "BTC 4h · trend" ? 2.0 : preset == "ETH 1h · break" ? 1.5 :
           preset == "ETH 30m · reclaim" ? 1.5 : preset == "SOL 4h · trend (rolling)" ? 2.0 : 2.0
pStopK   = preset == "BTC 4h · trend" ? 6.0 : preset == "ETH 1h · break" ? 1.0 :
           preset == "ETH 30m · reclaim" ? 1.0 : preset == "SOL 4h · trend (rolling)" ? 0.5 : 1.0
pHold    = preset == "ETH 1h · break" ? 4 : preset == "ETH 30m · reclaim" ? 24 : 0
pRvol    = preset == "BTC 4h · trend" ? 1.5 : preset == "SOL 4h · trend (rolling)" ? 0.0 : 2.5
pAnchorH = preset == "ETH 30m · reclaim" ? 8 : 0
pRoll    = preset == "SOL 4h · trend (rolling)" ? 24 :
           preset == "XAUUSD 5m · break (rolling)" ? 1152 : 0

modeIn   = input.string("break", "Entry family", options=["trend","fade","break","reclaim","pullback"])
bandKIn  = input.float(2.0,  "Band width (volume-weighted σ)", minval=0.5, step=0.5)
stopKIn  = input.float(1.0,  "Stop (volume-weighted σ)",       minval=0.1, step=0.5)
holdIn   = input.int(0,      "Max hold (bars, 0 = to session end)", minval=0)
rvolIn   = input.float(2.5,  "Min relative volume (0 = off)",  minval=0.0, step=0.5)
anchorHIn= input.int(0,      "Session anchor hour (UTC)",      minval=0, maxval=23)
rollIn   = input.int(0,      "Rolling VWAP window (bars, 0 = session-anchored)", minval=0)
rvolLen  = input.int(1920,   "Relative-volume baseline (bars)", minval=50,
     tooltip="The Python kernel uses 1920 bars on whatever timeframe it runs, so " +
             "this is a long baseline by design. Same number here for parity.")

manual   = preset == "Manual"
mode     = manual ? (modeIn=="trend"?0 : modeIn=="fade"?1 : modeIn=="break"?2 : modeIn=="reclaim"?3 : 4) : pMode
bandK    = manual ? bandKIn   : pBandK
stopK    = manual ? stopKIn   : pStopK
maxHold  = manual ? holdIn    : pHold
minRvol  = manual ? rvolIn    : pRvol
anchorH  = manual ? anchorHIn : pAnchorH
rollWin  = manual ? rollIn    : pRoll

// ------------------------------------------------------------------- vwap ---
tp = (high + low + close) / 3.0
v  = volume <= 0 ? 1.0 : volume

// session reset: at the anchor hour, or at the UTC day boundary when anchor = 0
mod       = hour * 60 + minute
anchorMod = anchorH * 60
newSess   = anchorMod == 0 ? ta.change(time("1D")) != 0
                           : (nz(mod[1], -1) < anchorMod and mod >= anchorMod)

var float cpv  = 0.0
var float cv   = 0.0
var float cp2v = 0.0
if newSess
    cpv  := 0.0
    cv   := 0.0
    cp2v := 0.0
cpv  := cpv  + tp * v
cv   := cv   + v
cp2v := cp2v + tp * tp * v

sessVwap = cv > 0 ? cpv / cv : tp
sessVar  = cv > 0 ? (cp2v / cv) - sessVwap * sessVwap : 0.0
sessStd  = math.sqrt(math.max(sessVar, 0.0))

// rolling variant — the only anchor that makes sense on a market with no session
rw       = math.max(rollWin, 1)
rpv      = math.sum(tp * v, rw)
rv       = math.sum(v, rw)
rp2v     = math.sum(tp * tp * v, rw)
rollVwap = rv > 0 ? rpv / rv : tp
rollVar  = rv > 0 ? (rp2v / rv) - rollVwap * rollVwap : 0.0
rollStd  = math.sqrt(math.max(rollVar, 0.0))

useRoll = rollWin > 0
vwap    = useRoll ? rollVwap : sessVwap
vwstd   = useRoll ? rollStd  : sessStd
upper   = vwap + bandK * vwstd
lower   = vwap - bandK * vwstd

// relative volume, baseline shifted one bar so the current bar cannot see itself
rvolBase = ta.sma(v, rvolLen)[1]
rvol     = nz(rvolBase) > 0 ? v / rvolBase : 0.0
rvolOK   = minRvol <= 0.0 or rvol >= minRvol

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- entries ---
// Every rule is evaluated on the CLOSED bar; TradingView fills the order at the
// next bar's open, which is exactly what the Python kernel assumes.
var int stretchUp = 0
var int stretchDn = 0
if newSess
    stretchUp := 0
    stretchDn := 0
if high >= upper
    stretchUp := 1
if low <= lower
    stretchDn := 1

longSig  = false
shortSig = false
if mode == 0            // trend — long above VWAP, short below
    longSig  := close > vwap and close[1] <= vwap[1]
    shortSig := close < vwap and close[1] >= vwap[1]
else if mode == 1       // fade — close beyond a band, take the other side
    longSig  := close < lower
    shortSig := close > upper
else if mode == 2       // break — close beyond a band, go with it
    longSig  := close > upper
    shortSig := close < lower
else if mode == 3       // reclaim — was stretched, now closes back through VWAP
    longSig  := stretchDn == 1 and close > vwap and close[1] <= vwap[1]
    shortSig := stretchUp == 1 and close < vwap and close[1] >= vwap[1]
else                    // pullback — trending away, take the first touch back
    longSig  := close[1] > vwap[1] and low <= vwap and close > vwap
    shortSig := close[1] < vwap[1] and high >= vwap and close < vwap

canTrade = rvolOK and vwstd > 0 and barstate.isconfirmed
stopDist = stopK * vwstd

if canTrade and longSig and strategy.position_size <= 0
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
    strategy.exit("L x", "L", stop=close - stopDist)
if canTrade and shortSig and strategy.position_size >= 0
    strategy.entry("S", strategy.short)
    strategy.exit("S x", "S", stop=close + stopDist)

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ exits ---
// Session end when holding to the horizon, or a fixed bar count when the config
// sets one. The trend family also flips on a close back through VWAP.
barsHeld = ta.barssince(strategy.position_size[1] == 0 and strategy.position_size != 0)
if strategy.position_size != 0
    if maxHold > 0 and barsHeld >= maxHold
        strategy.close_all("hold")
    else if maxHold == 0 and newSess
        strategy.close_all("session")
    else if mode == 0 and strategy.position_size > 0 and close < vwap
        strategy.close_all("flip")
    else if mode == 0 and strategy.position_size < 0 and close > vwap
        strategy.close_all("flip")

// ------------------------------------------------------------------- plot ---
plot(vwap,  "VWAP",  color.new(color.orange, 0), 2)
plot(upper, "Upper", color.new(color.gray, 40))
plot(lower, "Lower", color.new(color.gray, 40))
bgcolor(rvolOK and minRvol > 0 ? color.new(color.teal, 92) : na)

strategies.pine:
//@version=6
// =============================================================================
// H-003 · EMA × VWAP cross  —  board score 4.0/10  —  REJECTED
// prop_lab · https://github.com/KristijonasSim/prop_lab
//
// DO NOT TRADE THIS. Kept for completeness.
//
// WHY IT WAS REJECTED: 284,000 backtests across 9 markets, 3m to 1d, all four
// exits. Real median PF 0.705 against a phase-randomised null's 0.757 — WORSE
// THAN NOISE. On walk-forward the null produced MORE gate-clearing cells than
// the real data (17 vs 10). Gold 1h reached walk-forward PF 2.356 but is one
// survivor in 48 where the null gave two.
//
// One real finding survives and is kept: a relative-volume filter is a genuine
// positive lever (rvol > 1.5 scored +0.076 paired lift, and rvol > 1.0 improved
// 74.6% of configurations — the highest rate in the project). An EMA SLOPE
// filter is genuinely NEGATIVE (-0.024) and has been removed here.
// =============================================================================
strategy("H-003 EMA x VWAP cross · prop_lab [REJECTED]", overlay=true,
     initial_capital=10000, default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity,
     default_qty_value=100, commission_type=strategy.commission.percent,
     commission_value=0.05, margin_long=100, margin_short=100, pyramiding=0)

emaLen   = input.int(21,     "EMA length", minval=2)
exitMode = input.string("cross back", "Exit", options=["cross back","price vs EMA","fixed R","session close"])
stopATR  = input.float(3.0,  "Stop (ATR)", minval=0.1, step=0.5)
rrIn     = input.float(2.0,  "Target (R multiple, fixed-R exit only)", minval=0.1, step=0.5)
maxHold  = input.int(0,      "Max hold (bars, 0 = off)", minval=0)
minRvol  = input.float(1.5,  "Min relative volume (0 = off)", minval=0.0, step=0.5,
     tooltip="The one lever in this hypothesis that measured positive. Default is " +
             "the best value found: rvol > 1.5, paired lift +0.076.")
rvolLen  = input.int(1920,   "Relative-volume baseline (bars)", minval=50)
atrLen   = input.int(14,     "ATR length", minval=2)

// session-anchored VWAP, reset at the UTC day
tp = (high + low + close) / 3.0
v  = volume <= 0 ? 1.0 : volume
newSess = ta.change(time("1D")) != 0
var float cpv = 0.0
var float cv  = 0.0
if newSess
    cpv := 0.0
    cv  := 0.0
cpv := cpv + tp * v
cv  := cv  + v
vwap = cv > 0 ? cpv / cv : tp

ema = ta.ema(close, emaLen)
a   = ta.atr(atrLen)

rvolBase = ta.sma(v, rvolLen)[1]
rvol     = nz(rvolBase) > 0 ? v / rvolBase : 0.0
rvolOK   = minRvol <= 0.0 or rvol >= minRvol

crossUp = ta.crossover(ema, vwap)
crossDn = ta.crossunder(ema, vwap)
canTrade = rvolOK and a > 0 and barstate.isconfirmed

if canTrade and crossUp and strategy.position_size <= 0
    st = close - stopATR * a
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
    if exitMode == "fixed R"
        strategy.exit("L x", "L", stop=st, limit=close + rrIn * (close - st))
    else
        strategy.exit("L x", "L", stop=st)
if canTrade and crossDn and strategy.position_size >= 0
    st = close + stopATR * a
    strategy.entry("S", strategy.short)
    if exitMode == "fixed R"
        strategy.exit("S x", "S", stop=st, limit=close - rrIn * (st - close))
    else
        strategy.exit("S x", "S", stop=st)

held = ta.barssince(strategy.position_size[1] == 0 and strategy.position_size != 0)
if strategy.position_size != 0
    if maxHold > 0 and held >= maxHold
        strategy.close_all("hold")
    else if exitMode == "cross back" and ((strategy.position_size > 0 and crossDn) or (strategy.position_size < 0 and crossUp))
        strategy.close_all("cross back")
    else if exitMode == "price vs EMA" and ((strategy.position_size > 0 and close < ema) or (strategy.position_size < 0 and close > ema))
        strategy.close_all("price/EMA")
    else if exitMode == "session close" and newSess
        strategy.close_all("session")

plot(vwap, "VWAP", color.new(color.orange, 0), 2)
plot(ema,  "EMA",  color.new(color.blue, 0), 2)

strategies.pine:
//@version=6
// =============================================================================
// H-001 · Opening Range Breakout  —  board score 2.4/10  —  REJECTED
// prop_lab · https://github.com/KristijonasSim/prop_lab
//
// DO NOT TRADE THIS. Kept for completeness and for re-checking by hand.
//
// WHY IT WAS REJECTED: 8,160 configurations on BTC — ZERO reached PF 1.20 at
// 1x cost, and only 6 exceeded 1.00. At ZERO fees the median was still 0.960,
// so there was no edge to protect: it is not a cost problem. Re-run across an
// 8-instrument FX and metals universe, 69 of 65,280 configs cleared 1.20 at 1x
// and NONE at 2x. Walk-forward on BTC stitched to PF 0.781. A filtered variant
// reached 1.165 — real lift, still under the gate and far too slow.
//
// The published version of this strategy is a CROSS-SECTIONAL basket: top 20 of
// 7,000 US stocks by opening relative volume, rebuilt daily. The single-symbol
// version tested here is the paper's own unfiltered variant, which scored Sharpe
// 0.48 in the paper. Sweeping parameters on one symbol cannot reproduce the part
// that carries the edge. (prop_lab tested the crypto cross-sectional analogue
// separately as H-007. It also failed.)
// =============================================================================
strategy("H-001 Opening Range Breakout · prop_lab [REJECTED]", overlay=true,
     initial_capital=10000, default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity,
     default_qty_value=100, commission_type=strategy.commission.percent,
     commission_value=0.05, margin_long=100, margin_short=100, pyramiding=0)

anchorH   = input.int(13,   "Session anchor hour (UTC)", minval=0, maxval=23,
     tooltip="13:30 UTC is the NY cash open — the best anchor of the 20 tested, " +
             "and still not good enough. 0 = UTC day.")
anchorM   = input.int(30,   "Session anchor minute", minval=0, maxval=59)
orBars    = input.int(4,    "Opening range length (bars)", minval=1)
stopATR   = input.float(1.0,"Stop (ATR)",  minval=0.1, step=0.5)
rrIn      = input.float(0.0,"Target (R multiple, 0 = hold to session end)", minval=0.0, step=0.5)
bufBps    = input.float(0.0,"Breakout buffer (bps)", minval=0.0, step=1.0)
minRvol   = input.float(0.0,"Min relative volume on the breakout bar (0 = off)", minval=0.0, step=0.5)
oneTrade  = input.bool(true,"One trade per session")
atrLen    = input.int(14,   "ATR length", minval=2)
rvolLen   = input.int(1920, "Relative-volume baseline (bars)", minval=50)

a   = ta.atr(atrLen)
mod = hour * 60 + minute
anc = anchorH * 60 + anchorM
newSess = anc == 0 ? ta.change(time("1D")) != 0
                   : (nz(mod[1], -1) < anc and mod >= anc)

var int   barsIn = 0
var float orH    = na
var float orL    = na
var bool  taken  = false
if newSess
    barsIn := 0
    orH    := high
    orL    := low
    taken  := false
else
    barsIn := barsIn + 1
    if barsIn < orBars
        orH := math.max(nz(orH, high), high)
        orL := math.min(nz(orL, low),  low)

rvolBase = ta.sma(volume, rvolLen)[1]
rvol     = nz(rvolBase) > 0 ? volume / rvolBase : 0.0
rvolOK   = minRvol <= 0.0 or rvol >= minRvol

ready = barsIn >= orBars and not na(orH) and a > 0 and barstate.isconfirmed
buf   = bufBps / 10000.0
upBrk = ready and close > orH * (1 + buf) and rvolOK and (not oneTrade or not taken)
dnBrk = ready and close < orL * (1 - buf) and rvolOK and (not oneTrade or not taken)

if upBrk and strategy.position_size <= 0
    st = close - stopATR * a
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
    taken := true
    if rrIn > 0
        strategy.exit("L x", "L", stop=st, limit=close + rrIn * (close - st))
    else
        strategy.exit("L x", "L", stop=st)
if dnBrk and strategy.position_size >= 0
    st = close + stopATR * a
    strategy.entry("S", strategy.short)
    taken := true
    if rrIn > 0
        strategy.exit("S x", "S", stop=st, limit=close - rrIn * (st - close))
    else
        strategy.exit("S x", "S", stop=st)

if rrIn == 0 and newSess and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all("session")

plot(ready ? orH : na, "OR high", color.new(color.blue, 0), 2, plot.style_linebr)
plot(ready ? orL : na, "OR low",  color.new(color.blue, 0), 2, plot.style_linebr)

strategies.tagline: Strip out BTC, fade what is left.
strategies.candidate: config re-chosen blind each quarter on 2x-cost train PF, 0.25% risk per trade
strategies.note: Rejected at stage 1. Zero of 1,152 configurations clear the gate at 2x cost and the paired-shuffle null beats the real data on every cut — more configs profitable before costs (55.4% vs 51.6%), higher median, higher best. This is the H-005 result again: a fade rule is EASIER to satisfy on shuffled data, because permuted series revert around their extremes more readily than real trending ones. The decisive diagnostic is the z-response, and it is flat — profit factor before any costs runs 1.000 / 0.997 / 1.006 / 1.013 as the entry threshold goes 1.5σ → 3.0σ. A three-sigma residual reverts no harder than a 1.5-sigma one, so the size of the deviation carries no information about what comes next. Nothing here is cost-limited; there is no edge to protect. Note every walk-forward fold selected a config whose TRAIN profit factor was already below 1.0 — the selector could not find a winner even in sample. Taken with H-007 this closes a family: continuation and reversion on the same relative structure, in opposite directions, both dead at retail cost.

The recommended row is the fewest expected days to a funded account among the levels that keep the breach rate under 5% and the drawdown inside the 8% cap.
